decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location planSK 01 A SK 01 B SK 02 SK 03 SuDS proformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a design which complies with Development Plan Policies.

Notwithstanding the details set out in the submitted SuDS pro forma, prior to the commencement of any construction work, details of the Sustainable Drainage Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and must conform with the Landscaping Strategy. The details shall include:o	Results of infiltration testing to determine the applicability of full and partial infiltration. If infiltration is not deemed acceptable through infiltration testing an appropriate attenuation feature must be provided in line with the London Plan Drainage Hierarchy.o	Final sizes, storage volumes, invert levels, cross-sections and specifications of all SuDS measures including rain gardens, permeable paving, and soakaways Management Plan for future maintenance.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD 61, and Policies 5.12 & 5.13 of the London Plan and the NPPF.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time. Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality in accordance with relevant adopted planning policies of the Enfield Local Plan.
